summary:
I've been building a SillyTavern-based interview tool for AI character creation — you sit through a guided interview instead of one-shotting a prompt, and it produces a structured brief plus a matching lorebook before the card ever gets written. Before starting the build I surveyed the existing extensions in that space: one incumbent has 157 stars and does none of this — no interview, no persistent brief, no lorebook authoring alongside the character. That gave me a clear lane instead of a guess.

The interesting bug from this cycle: my forge kept rewriting a saved character brief out from under itself. On any device that hadn't seen the interview transcript, the build step would "fill in the gaps" by inventing a whole new backstory and silently overwrite the real one — a farm patriarch became a knight because the code was reasoning from an empty conversation history. Fix was to make it recognize "I have no transcript here" and build from the saved brief instead of guessing. Small check, but it was the difference between the tool being trustworthy and it randomly rewriting someone's work.

I also spent a chunk of time on a P100 GPU that four different services share — a chat model, an image generator, and an automation brain all have to take turns on one card. Getting simultaneous users working without the model reloading (and eating a 10-second stall) each time meant switching from a plain queue to something that runs two conversations in parallel and only swaps models when the workload actually changes. Turned a single-user bottleneck into something that holds up under concurrent load.

Most of the rest was plumbing: getting a self-hosted git setup talking cleanly to GitHub for a side contribution to a friend's open-source project, and closing out the last of the character tool's image-generation pipeline — auto-portraits, gallery scenes, face-consistent renders — so the whole loop from "describe a character" to "here's their card, lore, and art" runs without leaving the chat app.

highlights.oneLiner: SillyTavern interview-first character creation tool with brief+lorebook before card writing
Single P100 shared across chat/image/brain models, now parallel dual-slot instead of serialized queue
